name: opencode-kiro
description: ACP-compliant Kiro provider plugin for OpenCode 2.x with kiro-cli login auth, model discovery, strict provider ownership, and TUI credits display

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/tui.tsx --outfile dist/tui.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/rpc.ts --outfile dist/rpc.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/provider/index.ts --outfile dist/provider.js --target node --format esm
